create_MetricLogger: create a MetricLogger to track and log training metrics like loss and accuracy over iterations
create_SmoothedValue: create a SmoothedValue object to track a rolling window of metric values with median and global average
build_NestedTensor: build a NestedTensor from a list of variable-sized image tensors using nested_tensor_from_tensor_list
init_distributed_mode: init distributed training mode by calling init_distributed_mode with an args object containing rank and world size
run_all_gather: run all_gather to collect arbitrary picklable data from all distributed process ranks into a single list
